title: UP Diliman grad tops metallurgical engineers licensure exam
summary: A graduate of UP Diliman was the top scorer in the computer-based licensure examination for metallurgical engineers, the Professional Regulation Commission said.

blocks.text: A graduate of the University of the Philippines - Diliman was the top scorer in the computer-based licensure examination for metallurgical engineers, the Professional Regulation Commission said.
According to the PRC, 36 test takers out of 42 passed the exam, given by the Board of Metallurgical Engineering at test centers in Metro Manila, Cagayan de Oro, Cebu and Lucena this month.
Lyle Christopher Junas Ondac of UP Diliman achieved the top score of 89.50%.
